y-m-66-09.title: Kubatanidza chakawanikwa, kuenzanisa nzira mbiri
y-m-66-09.topic: Nzira dzokubatanidza: kusarudza mabasa mukubatanidza chakawanikwa
y-m-66-09.goal: Enzanisa kuti, mukubatanidza chakawanikwa, sarudzo dzose mbiri dze "chinhu chipi chokusiyanisa nechipi chokubatanidza" dzinopa zvirevo zvakarurama asi imwe inogona kunaka kana kuipa zvichienderana nechinangwa, uye utsanangure mutemo wokusarudza nemienzaniso miviri.
y-m-66-09.material: Vanhu vaviri vari kuyedza kutsvaga ∫ x·e^x dx. (Rirevere se: integral ye x nguva e kusimba rex, dx. Pano e^x ibasa rexponential. Shandisa fomula yepfungwa dzokutanga dziri pamusoro.) Hayun: ngati f = x uye g′ = e^x, zvichipa x·e^x − ∫ e^x dx = x·e^x − e^x + C. Dohyun: ngati f = e^x uye g′ = x, uye akanyora kusvika (x²/2)·e^x − ∫ (x²/2)·e^x dx akamira. Mativi okurudyi ezvirevo zvose mbiri anobva pafomula.
y-m-66-09.thinking.1: Tarisa kuparadzanisa kwakanyanya ("nguva dzose siyanisa x")
y-m-66-09.prereq.1: Mutemo we product wema derivatives nefomula inobva pawo, ∫ f·g′ dx = f·g − ∫ f′·g dx
y-m-66-09.prereq.2: Indefinite integral ye e^x ndi e^x, uye derivative ye ln x ndi 1/x
y-m-66-09.prereq.3: Padanho iri unogona kugamuchira sechokwadi kuti indefinite integral ye ln x ndi x ln x − x
y-m-66-09.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvirevo zvose zvakarurama nezvenzira dzevanhu vaviri.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.hint.0: Mu equation yekutanga yaDohyun, nyora kuti f ne g′ ndezvei uye f′ ne g ndezvei, uye uzvienzanise nechimiro chedivi rekurudyi refomula.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa, nechimiro, ma integrals akasiiwa naHayun naDohyun pakupedzisira, ∫ e^x dx ne ∫ (x²/2)·e^x dx, nenyaya yekutanga ∫ x·e^x dx.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.o.a: Equation yekutanga yaDohyun inewo equation yakarurama yakanyorwa kuti ikodzere fomula
y-m-66-09.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvakaenzanisa f, g′, f′, ne g nefomula.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.o.b: Dohyun akatsiva mabasa e f ne g′, saka akashandisa fomula zvisina kururama
y-m-66-09.s.s1.r.b: Izvi hazvina kuongorora kana fomula ichishanda chero divi ripi f ne g′ rakaiswa.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.o.c: Nzira yaDohyun haina kushata, asi integral yasara inova yakaoma zvakanyanya, izvo zvisina kukodzera nyaya iyi
y-m-66-09.s.s1.r.c: Izvi zvakasiyanisa equation yakarurama nekuva nani kana kushata kunoenderana nechinangwa.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.o.d: Nenzira yaDohyun, chero wagadzirisa sei, uchapedzisira wawana mhedzisiro yakasiyana neyaHayun
y-m-66-09.s.s1.r.d: Izvi zvakasiya kuti indefinite integrals dzakafanana kunze kwemusiyano we constant. Yakatora nzira yakashata nenzira isingakodzeri sezvinhu zvimwe chete.
y-m-66-09.s.s1.explain: Equation yekutanga yaDohyun equation yakarurama inoshandisa fomula chaizvo ne f = e^x, g′ = x, f′ = e^x, g = x²/2. Asi integral yasara ∫ (x²/2)·e^x dx ine power yepamusoro ye x kupfuura nyaya yekutanga uye yakaoma zvikuru, saka haisi yakanaka munyaya iyi.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino ndi ∫ x·ln x dx. Chirevo chakakodzera chinoongorora sarudzo "sezvakaita Hayun, ita kuti x ive f (chikamu chekusiyanisa)" ndechipi?
y-m-66-09.s.s2.hint.0: Kune sarudzo mbiri (f = x kana f = ln x), tsvaga uye unyore f′ ne g yeimwe neimwe, uye uenzanise kuti sarudzo ipi inoita kuti g ive nyore kutsvaga.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.hint.1: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, nyora chimiro che integral yasara ∫ f′·g dx uye uenzanise kana chiri nyore kupfuura integral yekutanga.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.o.a: Unofanira kutanga watsvaga g = ∫ ln x dx, saka f = ln x inoratidzika nyore.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.r.a: Vakasarudza nekuenzanisa chimiro che integral yasara nekuverenga kwepakati kunodiwa.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.o.b: x ndiyo expression iri nyore zvikuru, saka inogara iri yakanakisa kutora x se f mu product ipi neipi.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.r.b: Vakapfuvura nyaya imwe yakashanda, product ne e^x, kuma products ose.
y-m-66-09.s.s2.o.c: ln x haigoni kuita integrated, saka kuisarudza se g′ hakugoneki mune imwe nyaya
y-m-66-09.s.s2.r.c: Izvi zvakaona sekusingagoneki nekuti hazvina kuziva kuti indefinite integral ye ln x iripo (x ln x − x).
y-m-66-09.s.s2.explain: Kana ukaita f = x ne g′ = ln x, unofanira kutanga watsvaga g = x ln x − x. Kana ukaita f = ln x ne g′ = x, saka f′ = 1/x ne g = x²/2, uye integral yasara ndi ∫ (x/2) dx, iri nyore zvikuru. Saka munyaya iyi zviri nani kuisa ln x padivi rinosiyaniswa.
y-m-66-09.s.s3.prompt: Enzanisa sarudzo yechikamu chekusiyanisa (f) mu ∫ x·e^x dx ne ∫ x·ln x dx, uye unyore mutemo wekusarudza f, uchitaura mhedzisiro yenyaya mbiri.

y-m-66-09.s.s3.model.0: Mu x·e^x, kana ukaita f = x, inova 1 kana yasiyaniswa uye integral yasara ingori e^x, iri nyore. Mu x·ln x, kusiyanisa ln x kunopa 1/x, inova nyore kana yasangana ne x, saka unoita f = ln x. Mutemo ndewekusarudza divi rinova nyore kana f yasiyaniswa uye rinoita integral yasara kuva nyore.
y-m-66-09.s.s3.model.1: Panzvimbo pemutemo "x inogara iri f," enzanisa kana integral yasara ∫ f′·g dx iri nyore kupfuura yekutanga. Munyaya ye e^x, kuisa x se f kunodzikisa power uye kunoita kuti zvive nyore, uye munyaya ye ln x, kuisa ln x se f kunoita kuti product ye g = x²/2 ne f′ = 1/x ive x/2, iri nyore. Kana ukaisa zvakapesana, zvose zvinova zvakaoma zvakanyanya.
y-m-66-09.s.s3.model.2: Mudambudziko re exponential function, tora x se f, uye mudambudziko re logarithmic function, tora ln x se f. Sarudza se f chikamu chine derivative iri nyore, uye utarise kana integral yasara inova nyore.
